records.levelOverrideReason: User-requested move from level A to level C.

records.editorialLevelReason: Nxe4 allows Bxd8, sacrificing the stationary Queen before Nxc3+ and recovery of the opposing Queen.
Bxg6+ gives a Bishop for a pawn to expose the Rook target; the later Rxf8 is not a recapture of that Bishop.
e3+ deliberately offers a pawn to the King before Bxb1; the preceding Bishop exchange is equal.

sacrificeReview.reason: The automatic played-mover grader misses the stationary Rook offered by Qd4. The legal hxg6 captures the Rook on g6; Nxg6+ then creates double check. The editorial C grade counts this actual accepted Rook sacrifice.

records.editorialLevelReason: Bxf5+ leaves the stationary Rook on d1 to Bxd1; two further Rook checks are needed before recovery. Four solver moves with a Rook sacrifice.
Qc3 allows Rxe1, sacrificing the stationary Rook before Nd5+ and Nxb6 win the Queen. Four solver moves.
